fact: The Ministry of Lands, Housing and Urban Development invited bids on 2 November 2026 (closing 2 December 2026) for advisory and supervision of the upgrade of the UGNLIS land information system using blockchain and artificial intelligence.
title: Procurement consultancy - Upgrade of the Uganda Land Information Management Solution (UGNLIS) Using Blockchain and Artificial Intelligence
publisher: Ministry of Lands, Housing and Urban Development
